data.one_liner: A single carousel widget with 54 built-in transitions and 15 animated page indicators.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive carousel widget supporting standard slides, 3D rotations, card stacks, Material 3 layouts, and various reveal animations. It includes features like infinite looping, autoplay, vertical/RTL support, and animated page indicators with zero external dependencies.
use_when: You need custom or 3D carousel transitions like cube, coverflow, or wheel without managing complex math.
You want animated page indicators that sync directly with the carousel state.
You need a carousel that supports infinite looping, autoplay, and keyboard/mouse interactions.
avoid_when: Your project cannot use external UI component libraries.
You only require a simple standard page view and want to minimize package overhead.
strengths: Contains 54 distinct carousel transitions and 15 animated indicators in a single package.
Supports custom effects via builders and poses.
weaknesses: Heavy usage of complex Slicer or custom strip animations on heavy widgets can impact performance.
Niche transitions might require careful tuning of viewport fractions and clipping.
